label: Last two copy-phase outputs of short sequences
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires only in the copy phase (never during original input or at <DEL>), concentrated on the final two output steps (to_go 0 or 1 hold ~94% of activation mass). It is strongly length-dependent: rate is highest for L=3 (33% of steps) and L=4 (21%), so the last two outputs of L<=4 sequences are active ~85% of the time, and it fades steadily for L>=7. Top activations are L=3 sequences at the final output (the input there is original token 1). Some weaker activations spill onto to_go=2-4 in longer sequences. Mild token modulation (input 1 or p raise the rate) but no clean token rule. Does not fire on the first output (recall_idx 0). Precision is limited because in long sequences the last two steps are usually inactive.
